Multi‑Trade Contractor in Atlanta, GA

If you need a single, accountable team to handle framing, roofing, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, drywall/paint, flooring, and exterior work, Build Heritage is the contractor you’ll want. We serve property managers, apartment communities, HOAs, brokers, and investors across metro Atlanta, and we provide a free, itemized quote within 48 hours.

Why Choose Build Heritage?

  • All‑in‑one expertise – Eight trades under one licensed and insured team, so you never have to juggle multiple subcontractors.
  • Transparent pricing – We deliver a detailed, itemized quote so you know exactly what you’re paying for.

What We Offer

| Service | Description | |---------|-------------| | Framing | Structural skeletons built to code. | | Roofing | Roof installation, repair, and maintenance. | | Plumbing | Water supply, drainage, and fixture installation. | | Electrical | Wiring, panels, and lighting solutions. | | HVAC | Heating, ventilation, and air‑conditioning systems. | | Drywall/Paint | Interior finishes that protect and beautify. | | Flooring | Interior flooring work. | | Exterior | Exterior work. |

All work is performed by a single team, so communication is streamlined and accountability is clear.

How It Works

  1. Request a Quote – Request a quote through buildheritage.org.
  2. Get a Free Itemized Quote – We respond within 48 hours with a detailed estimate.
  3. Plan & Approve – Review the quote, make any adjustments, and approve the scope.
  4. Project Execution – Our team coordinates all trades.
  5. Completion & Review – We complete the work and hand the project over.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do you handle large apartment complexes? A: Yes, we serve apartment communities across metro Atlanta.

Q: Are you licensed and insured in Georgia? A: Yes, Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia.

Q: How long does a typical project take? A: Project duration varies by scope.
